text: {character:Wanjirou}She was so angry when she left. Hope she didn't do anything stupid...
Wanjirou
Midari Ikishima
Miki Nikaidou
Yumeko Jabami
{character:Mary Saotome}D-D-D-DOOOOOOOG MONSTER!
Mary Saotome
{character:Mary Saotome}How can you be so calm? You are the one who's being weird!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Oh, what's the matter, Wanjirou? Did you offend our guests?
{character:Wanjirou}I'm the one being offended, woof!
{character:Mary Saotome}A human? Are you an exorcist? Please! Dispel this monster!
{character:Mary Saotome}Ah, wait a second. If you've appeared in a place like this, who knows what you are? What monster are you? A beautiful lady in a kimono... I get it! You're the Snow Woman!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}The Snow Woman doesn't appear at this time of year. Don't worry, I'm a human and a guest here, just like you.
{character:Wanjirou}You come here too often to be a guest, don't you think, woof?
{character:Wanjirou}I'm not good at this... It's my fault. I'm counting on you, Nikaidou.
{character:Mary Saotome}What are you two whispering about? Where on earth is this place? Who are you guys? Explain! Immediately! Now!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Such an impatient guest. Before we explain, let's go through the routine first.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}The Mahjong Soul...
{character:Mary Saotome}Shrine?
{character:Mary Saotome}Hmm... So, this is a shrine where any wish can be granted. And we're here because we have some wishes, right?
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Any wish can be granted? Sounds awesome.
{character:Mary Saotome}Not awesome at all! Doesn't it sound like a religious scam?
{character:Mary Saotome}I can't think of any off the top of my head. We're perfectly happy and healthy, so we're good.
{character:Mary Saotome}Let's quit wasting our time here. Let's go, Yumeko.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Eh? But they can grant our wishes here. Wouldn't it be a big waste to leave?
{character:Mary Saotome}You actually believe in this... Stay, then. I'll go without you. Uh, how do I get out of here?
{character:Wanjirou}I'm not quite sure about how to answer your question, woof. This shrine is not a place that you can just come and go as you wish.
{character:Mary Saotome}Huh?!
{character:Mary Saotome}Are you... kidding me?
Miki&Yumeko
{character:Miki Nikaidou}It's windy tonight. I'm sure the wind has calmed her down by now.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}…
{character:Midari Ikishima}Still ignoring me. Never mind, as long as we continue the game... You'll look at me eventually. Look at me! Yumeko!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Wow, so energetic.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}(Her own plans, hmm... But that look wasn't really reassuring.)
{character:Miki Nikaidou}(After all, this shrine is bigger than you'd think… She's probably lost her way by now, hehe.)
{character:Yumeko Jabami}I'm familiar with the rules now. Let's start the next game. Yet... I can't help but feel something is missing.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}You've got a point. The night is long. Mahjong alone won't be enough to pass the time.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Wow, Miss Nikaidou and I are on the same wavelength. What kind of penalty, then?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}So impatient... Wanjirou, we haven't finished the takeout Ichihime ordered today, right?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}That's right, hehe. The one who finishes in the last place will eat a whole plate of spicy food as a penalty.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Oh?! Does it taste legit?
{character:Midari Ikishima}So it's deadly spicy, right? Hehe, it's so spicy it'll burn your nerves off, right…? Alright! Deal!
{character:Wanjirou}Wait, woof! Doesn't my opinion matter, woof?!
Meanwhile...
{character:Mary Saotome}... I'm completely lost.
{character:Mary Saotome}*Sigh*... What time is it?
{character:Mary Saotome}(I should be able to see more clearly during the day. Generally speaking, I'd better find somewhere to stay overnight, but how am I gonna fall asleep somewhere this sketchy?)
{character:Mary Saotome}How long am I gonna stay here…? I have things to do tomorrow. And... Tomorrow is the last day of the field trip.
{character:Mary Saotome}The research topic... I haven't even started on it yet.
This field trip isn't just about relaxing.
{character:Mary Saotome}That Student Council President chose this specific topic just for fun. I'm sure of it.
{character:Mary Saotome}Like what is the meaning of this? Is she looking down upon the meaning of education?!
{character:???}Just for fun, yes. But I did consider carefully before choosing the topic.
{character:Mary Saotome}Eh? Did somebody just say something?!
{character:Mary Saotome}President... Kirari Momobami.
Kirari Momobami
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Calm down, Mary.
Mary ignores Yumeko's calls and leaves on her own. In a matter of seconds, she is out of sight.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Mary probably has her own plans. Don't worry, she can take care of herself.
Saotome, who has lost count of how many times she has returned to the shrine gate, is resting against the torii pillar.
{character:Kirari Momobami}Good evening, Mary Saotome. Are you also here to visit?
{character:Wanjirou}Ron!
{character:Wanjirou}I told you I'm not a dog monster! I'm the Dog God, woof!
{character:Wanjirou}Nonsense, woof! We are an authentic shrine, and I am an authentic god.
{character:Wanjirou}How dare you mortals be so rude... Never mind. I'm not some inferior god who bickers with mortals. Tell me, what are your wishes, woof?
{character:Mary Saotome}Screw it. There's a path there. If you don't show me the way, I'll find my own way.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Wait, Mary, Mary—
{character:Midari Ikishima}Wait, that 'blonde loser-cat' is here, too?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}So, shall we place some bets? Like... Do you want to play a penalty game?
{character:Wanjirou}Woof?! What? Are you thinking what I'm thinking?!
{character:Miki&Yumeko}Oops.//nOops.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Of course! Ichihime has confirmed it's spicy and delicious.
Hyakkaou Private Academy sees field trips as an important part of education, so, naturally they have given the students a "research topic" to finish.
And of course, this topic is really Hyakkaou-styled.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Welcome to the Mahjong Soul Shrine, our two lost guests.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Oops, my bad. Then, please let the shrine staff member meticulously comfort our nervous guests!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}To leave, you need some help from 'fate', hehe.
{character:Midari Ikishima}Tsk, Mangan? That's more points than me.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Three consecutive Mangan. You are on a roll, Wanjirou.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Here! 8,000 points. These rules are so exciting, just like I thought they'd be.
{character:Wanjirou}You've dealt in 2 Mangan in a row, and you're still so chill, woof? By the way, is your friend really okay on her own?
